title: Wandering Island
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Mikura Amelia lives alone with her cat and runs an air-delivery service, flying a vintage seaplane to remote Japanese islands in the Pacific (Dark Horse blurb). After her grandfather dies she finds an undelivered parcel addressed to an island that may not exist, and sets out to find it. Two volumes so far; MangaUpdates lists the series on hiatus.
life_message: A free, self-reliant life of adventure and curiosity, honoring a grandparent's unfinished task.
